notes.title: One Shell Straight to Hell release date reveal!
notes.notes:
Dear Brothers and Sisters, your one and only Padre Alexander is coming back in [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] on February 9, 2021! 

That’s right, Padre Alexander is back, heavily armed to fight off hordes of demons while doing his best to help the Halliwell family. Join the fight in [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i], the isometric, dungeon-crawling roguelike shooter. 

[i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] will descend you into ever-changing dungeons that overflow with demonic enemies and put your insane skills and over the top weapons to the test against the satanic hordes. To survive you must shout orders to your allies, lay your traps, and raise your gun to lay waste to your enemies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

[b] Key Features: [/b]
[list]
[*]Perplexing monsters- Ranging from the possessed kitchen drawer to drunken long-dead pirate captains and... I almost forgot, demons... a lot of demons.
[*]Regular weapons using a variety of ammunition, holy weapons drawing on your faith, and unholy weapons craving for your blood.
[*]Skill tree that makes you stronger and adds to the strategy.
[*]Base building... at least kind of. You will be able to build small factories to prepare...
[*]Traps for your enemies.
[*]Global enchantments
[*]Power-ups
[*]Randomly generated ‘dungeon’ maps
[*]And some more crazy absurd stuff!
[/list]

Take a look at the newest trailer of [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i]:  
[previewyoutube=PZkPm87qP6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DARQ’s Complete Edition release date confirmed
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Brothers and Sisters, DARQ’s Complete Edition release date has been confirmed![/h1]

On the [b]4th of December 2020[/b], our friendly dev team [b]Unfold Games[/b] will be releasing a new [u]FREE [/u]DLC called [i][b]The Crypt[/b][/i] for their award-winning game - [i][b]DARQ[/b][/i]. On the same day, [i][b]DARQ: Complete Edition[/b][/i] will be released on consoles. 

[b][i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i][/b] will come out with two DLCs included - [i][b]The Tower[/b][/i], which has been already released on PC, and the aforementioned new DLC - [i][b]The Crypt[/b][/i].

[h2]DARQ: Complete Edition will be available on the following platforms: [/h2]
[list]
[*] PC
[*] Xbox One
[*] PlayStation 4
[*] Nintendo Switch - Early 2021
[*] Xbox Series X|S, PS5 will receive a FREE UPGRADE in early 2021
[/list]

[h3]Let us tell you a little bit more about DARQ, in case you are not familiar with it.[/h3]

A sleeping boy, Lloyd, becomes aware of being experiencing a dream. That dream quickly changes into a nightmare which haunts him over and over again. Your mission is to help him end these dreams by solving puzzles, defying gravity and keeping an open mind. But be careful! The gloomy, abstract world is filled with creepy creatures lurking in the corners.

[u][b]Find out more and grab free digital gifts about DARQ here[/b][/u]:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq[/url]

If you can't wait for the Complete Edition, dive straight into Lloyd’s lucid dreams on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/433550/DARQ/ 

Join Lloyd and help him wake up!

notes.notes: A minor update containing bugfixes and small tweaks

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
ACHIEVEMENTS are finally here!

Of course several fixes and tweaks too :)

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1]New features and fixes[/h1]

[b] Language Support [/b]
[list]
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]French
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]

[b]Death/Sin - Resurrection/Redemption system[/b]
There was no penalty of your failures and sins. It has changed...

[b]Enhanced Combat[/b]
Faster melee combat and stronger weapons, but the enemies also learned new tricks to surprise you.

[b]New Weapons and Items[/b]
A crossbow and a rifle for the shooters, an old rusty machete for the slashers. You just have to find them.

[b]New scenes and puzzles[/b]
Plenty of new areas and a new fullscreen puzzle also added.

[b]New Cutscenes[/b]
When you enter a new area a quick flythrough camera helps you a bit

[b]Smaller additions[/b]
[list]
[*]New music tracks
[*]New voice lines
[*]Story changes and new elements
[*]Puzzle hint system
[*]An annoying but helpful companion on your journey
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for all the feedback![/b] 
We were (and still are) in joy with all the kind things you guys have said about our game thus far. Rest assured, we have paid close attention to your criticism and are focused on making [b]The Padre[/b] better than ever.

Right off the bat however, we could not solve every issue, but we are determined to transform our "promising" game to a great one.

The Upcoming Changes and the Reasoning Them;
[list]
[*]We added three new rooms to the story - just because ;)
[*]Two new weapons will appear somewhere in the mansion: Based on user feedback
[*]In-game cutscenes added - We would like to make the game more movie-like, and draw you into the story, this seems to be a great tool to do that.
[*]Puzzle Hints: some of you had problems with our puzzles. We did not want to make them easier, but instead added hints to understand their mechanisms better.
[*]Zombies are more unpredictable, fast and deadly in close combat - We want to move away from close combat and make it a last resort. To be honest, it was not fun. We would like you to have fun.
[*]Some items were hidden but not intentionally. Now you can see them.
[/list]
 
As stated earlier, we are updating the game constantly, but there are a lot of things to improve. This is our first update. There are many more still to come.

We are confident that the game will slowly grow longer and overall, more fun!

And lastly, we would like to hear your voice about the changes! That’s the easiest way for us to know if we’re going in the right direction!

Till next time,

The Padre Team
